content: Promissor, porém com bugs. O aplicativo é belo, simples e promissor, mas ainda tem alguns bugs para ser corrigidos. O mais irritante é o não funcionamento da opção repetir despesas. Criei varias despesas com essa função. Em nenhuma delas funcionou.

But unfortunately, the synchronization with bank accounts are really poor: sometimes it doesn't links with savings account (my case: [MARCA]), and sometimes takes a life or even doesn't syncs with a specific bank account (my case: [MARCA]).
Hopefully you guys could focus in this feature and improve it! 🙏

Disappointing customer experience. I’ve bought the lifetime premium of [APP] and started used the tool until one day I lost 100% of my transactions. 

I opened a ticket with their support and the solution was to reinstall the app and sync again with my bank, which worked, but worked but I would have to classify all of transaction again!!! I lost almost 5 hours of work doing that...

Unfortunately, the support team was not able to recover the transactions and when I asked for a refund, the answer was that is is not available because the issue was solved. Which issue was solved??

They are not serious at all. Have this in mind before buying the app.

Lack of basic functionalities. Some basic functionalities are missing:
- there is no option to sort/group expenses by category or date.
- it doesn't identify if the expense is from credit card.
- it is not possible to mark if an expense was already payed.
- it doesn't show if a recurrent expense is a parcelled purchase, and doesn't show the current parcel (1 / X).
- when changing a recurrent expense, it doesn't offer the option to change all the other future ones.
- it doesn't show all the weekly expenses inside the month, it just groups them as "future expenses".
